why.org_c:finding:06377: Internal vulnerability on vireo-willow-data-162 participating in attack paths toward the warehouse.

reasoning: We prioritized findings that actively lie on attack paths leading from the internet to the crown-jewel data store (org_c:ds:00001). Using the min_cut tool, we identified the smallest set of five finding fixes that completely disconnects all internet-based attack routes to the warehouse. Fixing these specific vulnerabilities efficiently neutralizes the highest-likelihood paths without needing to remediate thousands of unreachable high-CVSS findings.
